language.title: Language
language.desc: The language used across the interface.

org.name: Name
org.branding_desc: Customize how your server looks to members and people you invite.
org.logo_desc: Shown next to your server everywhere. Square image, at least 256×256.
org.background_desc: Wide image shown behind your invitation page. Landscape, at least 1600×900.
org.transfer_desc: Hand this server to another member. You will lose owner control.
org.transfer_modal_desc: The new owner gets full control of this server, including this danger zone. You will stay as a regular member.
org.delete_desc: Permanently deletes this server: libraries, members, settings and metadata. Book files on disk are not touched.
org.delete_modal_desc: This cannot be undone. Type {name} to confirm.

access.join_desc: Choose the server's entry point. Direct invitations from administrators are always allowed.
access.invite_only_desc: People need a direct invitation or an invite link to join.
access.request_desc: People request to join and an administrator approves them.
access.discoverable_desc: Anyone on this instance can find the server and join.
access.discord_desc: Add optional checks for people joining through an invite link.

system.search_elasticsearch_desc: External search engine with Japanese analyzer support
system.sso_disabled_desc: Set OIDC_ENABLED, OIDC_ISSUER and OIDC_CLIENT_ID to enable SSO login
system.queue_desc: Monitor and manage background job queues (book indexing, file events).
system.reindex_elasticsearch_desc: Rebuild the full Elasticsearch index for all books
system.reindex_pgroonga_desc: Not needed with PGroonga — data is always in sync
system.extract_cover_colors_desc: Reanalyze all ebook and audiobook covers to refresh their UI accent colors
system.rebuild_recommendations_desc: Regenerate recommendations for every organization where they are enabled

profile.desc: Your account profile is shared everywhere. Per-community overrides only apply inside that workspace.
profile.account_defaults_desc: The defaults shown in every community.
profile.profile_photo_desc: Upload a JPG, PNG, or WebP image up to 5MB.
profile.profile_banner_desc: Wide image shown at the top of your profile. Max 10MB.
profile.profile_color_desc: Used as your banner background when you don't have a banner image.
profile.community_desc: Customize how you appear inside {name}. Leave empty to use your account defaults.
profile.invalid_image: Please choose a valid image file

account.connected_accounts_desc: Link external accounts to your profile
account.active_sessions_desc: Devices where your account is currently signed in
account.sign_out_desc: Sign out of your current session on this device
account.danger_desc: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
account.delete_desc: This permanently deletes your account, reading progress, and all associated data. This cannot be undone.

opds.desc: Create API keys to access your book library from e-reader apps like KOReader, Moon+ Reader, Librera, or Calibre via OPDS.
opds.client_hint_pre: In your OPDS client, set the catalog URL to
opds.client_hint_post: with any username and your API key as the password.
opds.name_desc: A label to identify which device or app uses this key.
opds.created_desc: Copy this key now — you won't be able to see it again.

discord.desc: Restrict who can join via invite links based on Discord server membership and roles. Direct email invitations bypass these rules. If no rules are set, anyone can join.
discord.rule_hint: Users must satisfy at least one rule to join. Each rule requires guild membership and optionally a specific role. Users must have Discord linked in their account.
discord.none: No rules configured — access is open.
discord.add_rule_desc: Allow members of an entire Discord server or limit entry to people with a specific role.
discord.guild_help: Right-click your Discord server → Copy Server ID
discord.role_help: Leave empty to require only server membership
discord.label: Label
discord.label_help: A recognizable name for this requirement.

tasks.desc: Monitor background tasks and their progress
tasks.none_desc: Tasks will appear here when you scan a library or run background operations

metadata.desc: Configure metadata sources used to enrich this organization's books.
metadata.amazon_desc: When enabled, Nanahoshi searches Amazon for additional metadata after extracting local EPUB data: descriptions, series info, page count, ratings, genres, and high-quality covers. This is the default store; individual libraries can override it.
metadata.amazon_enabled_desc: Enable or disable Amazon as a metadata source for this organization.
metadata.amazon_domain_desc: The default regional store for this organization's libraries.
metadata.amazon_cookie_desc: If Amazon blocks requests with CAPTCHAs or 503 errors, paste your browser session cookie here. It's stored only for this organization.
metadata.ranobedb_desc: RanobeDB resolves titles, series, authors, publishers, ISBNs and ASINs from a locally imported dump — instantly and without rate limits. Per-volume ratings are fetched from the live API (toggle per library).
metadata.ranobedb_enabled_desc: Enable or disable RanobeDB as a metadata source for this organization.
metadata.ranobedb_dump_missing: The shared RanobeDB dump hasn't been imported yet. Ask an app administrator to run the import from System settings.

members.transfer_confirm: Transfer ownership to this member? You will become a regular member.
members.no_roles_to_assign: No roles to assign yet. Create one in the Roles section.

invitations.desc: Invite people to your server by email or with a shareable link.
invitations.links_desc: Shareable links to join this server
invitations.invite_member_desc: Send an email invitation to add a new member to your server.
invitations.no_mailer: Email isn't configured on this server (SMTP), so email invitations can't be sent. Use invite links below instead.
invitations.create_link_desc: Anyone with this link can join your server with the selected role.

roles_section.no_permission: You don't have permission to manage roles.
roles_section.desc: Use roles to group your server's members and assign permissions.
roles_section.default_permissions_desc: @everyone · Applies to all members of the server
roles_section.reorder_hint: Members use the color of the highest role they hold in this list. Drag roles to reorder them.
roles_section.none: No roles yet. Create one to get started.

recs.title: Recommendations
recs.desc: Personalized mixes on the dashboard and "Similar" sections on detail pages, computed nightly on this server. Turning this off stops the nightly job and hides the sections for every member.
recs.rebuild_desc: Recompute this server's mixes and similarities now, without waiting for the nightly job.

setup.title: Set up your server

setup.slug_hint: Short unique ID, generated from the name. You can edit it.
setup.fill_details: Fill in the server name first.

auth.sign_in_subtitle: Sign in to your library to continue.
auth.sign_up_subtitle: Set up your access to the library to get started.
auth.invite_only_note: This server is invite-only: you need an invite link or an email invitation from an administrator.
auth.name: Name

library.audible_region_hint: Catalog used to match audiobooks — pick the store matching this library's language.
library.scheduled_desc: Rescan automatically on a fixed interval.
library.provider_ranobedb_desc: Local light novel database — instant, no rate limits
library.provider_amazon_desc: Web scraping — adds ratings, covers and missing fields

library.access_unsaved_desc: Switching roles or members will discard permissions you have not saved yet.
